review:
[maya · changes] Logic is sound and meets acceptance on the fixture: hero seed {S-17.iban v2, S-22 v2}, row-only triage clean, root_candidates [crm, intake] with hop bound, seed window inclusive, recovery/seed/denied records never propagate, AST guard (no RunConfig/fault/culprit/fault_tick). t0 decision: the literal walk is unusable under I1 (seeds crm from tick 3, breaks B2 hero C=0); your skip-self-reads default is the right interim, but it under-taints a self-chain (verified: bad W1, crm reads it, writes W2, alert on W2 only -> t0=W2, W1 never seeded). That trades A8 conservatism against B2, both binding, so it goes to Aarav as B3-45 (recommend: tag reads view|tool, follow self-reads through tool reads only). Required now: (1) add a test pinning that gap (W1 not seeded under default, seeded under literal) so it is visible, not silent; (2) Taint carries t0_seq_est_literal beside t0_seq_est so the dry-run can report the delta, as your docstring promises. Tree note: test_world_triage_cause_is_s22_only now fails (KeyError) because tara's in-flight B3-44 edit to src/ks/world/scenario.py un-taints triage; B3-44 must update that test and the strict xfails.

[maya · done] Both required changes verified. (1) test_self_chain_gap_pinned: default seeds W2 only (IBAN v2 not tainted), literal walk seeds W1+W2; gap is visible, closed by B3-46 (Aarav's option C on B3-45). (2) Taint.t0_seq_est_literal always computed, t0_delta property; test_taint_carries_literal_t0_for_dry_run_delta checks delta > 0 on F2+ and 0 under follow_self_reads. World tests agree with B3-44 (triage clean, no xfails). tests/taint green; full suite green.
